lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਤਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਨਹ ॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: keeratana(n) saadhasa(n)gen naanak nah drisata(n)t jamadootanah ||34||
lines.translation: and sings the Kirtan of His Praises in the Saadh Sangat, O Nanak, shall never see the Messenger of Death. ||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਧਨੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nach duralabha(n) dhana(n) roopa(n) nach duralabha(n) svarag raajanah ||
lines.translation: Wealth and beauty are not so difficult to obtain. Paradise and royal power are not so difficult to obtain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਭੋਜਨੰ ਬਿੰਜਨੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸ੍ਵਛ ਅੰਬਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nach duralabha(n) bhojana(n) bi(n)jana(n) nach duralabha(n) svachh a(n)barah ||
lines.translation: Foods and delicacies are not so difficult to obtain. Elegant clothes are not so difficuilt to obtain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸੁਤ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nach duralabha(n) sut mitr bhraat baa(n)dhav nach duralabha(n) banitaa bilaasah ||
lines.translation: Children, friends, siblings and relatives are not so difficult to obtain. The pleasures of woman are not so difficult to obtain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਣੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਚਤੁਰ ਚੰਚਲਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nach duralabha(n) bidiaa prabeena(n) nach duralabha(n) chatur cha(n)chalah ||
lines.translation: Knowledge and wisdom are not so difficult to obtain. Cleverness and trickery are not so difficult to obtain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਨਾਮਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵਿੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: duralabha(n) ek bhagavaan naamah naanak labadhyi(n) saadhasa(n)g kripaa prabha(n) ||35||
lines.translation: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is difficult to obtain. O Nanak, it is only obtained by God's Grace, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤਹ ਤਤਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਮਰਤ ਪਯਾਲ ਲੋਕਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat katah tatah drisata(n) svarag marat payaal lokah ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, whether in this world, in paradise, or the nether regions of the underworld.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਲਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: sarabatr ramana(n) gobi(n)dah naanak lep chhep na lipyte ||36||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. O Nanak, no blame or stain sticks to Him. ||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਯਾ ਭਯੰਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੰ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟਾਂ ਸਖਾ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhayaa bhaya(n)t a(n)mrita(n) drusataa(n) sakhaa svajanah ||
lines.translation: Poison is transformed into nectar, and enemies into friends and companions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੰ ਭਯੰਤਿ ਸੁਖੵੰ ਭੈ ਭੀਤੰ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਯਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukha(n) bhaya(n)t sukhy(n) bhai bheeta(n) ta nirabhayah ||
lines.translation: Pain is changed into pleasure, and the fearful become fearless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਹ ॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: thaan bihoon bisraam naama(n) naanak kripaal har har gurah ||37||
lines.translation: Those who have no home or place find their place of rest in the Naam, O Nanak, when the Guru, the Lord, becomes Merciful. ||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੀਲ ਮਮੰ ਸੀਲੰ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਵਨ ਮਮ ਪਾਵਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab seel mama(n) seela(n) sarab paavan mam paavanah ||
lines.translation: He blesses all with humility; He has blessed me with humility as well. He purifies all, and He has purified me as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਰਤਬ ਮਮੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਲਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: sarab karatab mama(n) karataa naanak lep chhep na lipyte ||38||
lines.translation: The Creator of all is the Creator of me as well. O Nanak, no blame or stain sticks to Him. ||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੇਵਹ ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah seetala(n) cha(n)dr devah nah seetala(n) baavan cha(n)danah ||
lines.translation: The moon-god is not cool and calm, nor is the white sandalwood tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਸੀਤ ਰੁਤੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: nah seetala(n) seet ruten naanak seetala(n) saadh svajanah ||39||
lines.translation: The winter season is not cool; O Nanak, only the Holy friends, the Saints, are cool and calm. ||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ ਧੵਾਨੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)tra(n) raam raam naama(n) dhyaana(n) sarabatr pooranah ||
lines.translation: Through the Mantra of the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one meditates on the All-pervading Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੵਾਨੰ ਸਮ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖੰ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gyaana(n) sam dukh sukha(n) jugat niramal niravairanah ||
lines.translation: Those who have the wisdom to look alike upon pleasure and pain, live the immaculate lifestyle, free of vengeance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਯਾਲੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਆ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਵਰਜਿਤਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: dayaala(n) sarabatr jeeaa pa(n)ch dokh bivarajitah ||
lines.translation: They are kind to all beings; they have overpowered the five thieves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਅਲਪ ਮਾਯਾ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਰਹਤਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhojana(n) gopaal keeratana(n) alap maayaa jal kamal rahatah ||
lines.translation: They take the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise as their food; they remain untouched by Maya, like the lotus in the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੰ ਸਮ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: upadesa(n) sam mitr satrah bhagava(n)t bhagat bhaavanee ||
lines.translation: They share the Teachings with friend and enemy alike; they love the devotional worship of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਹ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ਆਪੁ ਤੵਿਾਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਣੁਕਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: par ni(n)daa nah srot sravana(n) aap tyiaag sagal renukah ||
lines.translation: They do not listen to slander; renouncing self-conceit, they become the dust of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਲਖੵਣ ਪੂਰਨੰ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: khat lakhyn poorana(n) purakhah naanak naam saadh svajanah ||40||
lines.translation: Whoever has these six qualities, O Nanak, is called a Holy friend. ||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਾ ਭੋਗੰਤ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੰ ਬਸੰਤੇ ਸਮੀਪਿ ਕੇਹਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajaa bhoga(n)t ka(n)d moola(n) basa(n)te sameep keharah ||
lines.translation: The goat enjoys eating fruits and roots, but if it lives near a tiger, it is always anxious.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤ੍ਰ ਗਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ ਬਿਆਪਤੇ ॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: tatr gate sa(n)saarah naanak sog harakha(n) biaapate ||41||
lines.translation: This is the condition of the world, O Nanak; it is afflicted by pleasure and pain. ||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨੰ ਅਪਰਾਧੰ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਮਲੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhala(n) chhidra(n) kot bighana(n) aparaadha(n) kilabikh mala(n) ||
lines.translation: Fraud, false accusations, millions of diseases, sins and the filthy residues of evil mistakes;

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹੰ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨੰ ਮਦੰ ਮਾਯਾ ਬਿਆਪਿਤੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam moha(n) maan apamaana(n) mada(n) maayaa biaapita(n) ||
lines.translation: doubt, emotional attachment, pride, dishonor and intoxication with Maya

lines.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਤੵੁ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਨਰਕਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵੰ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mrity janam bhrama(n)t narakah anik upaava(n) na sidhyte ||
lines.translation: these lead mortals to death and rebirth, wandering lost in hell. In spite of all sorts of efforts, salvation is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramala(n) saadh sa(n)gah japa(n)t naanak gopaal naama(n) ||
lines.translation: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, mortals become immaculate and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਮੰਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਹ ॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: rama(n)t gun gobi(n)d nit pratah ||42||
lines.translation: They continually dwell upon the Glorious Praises of God. ||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਮਣ ਸੀਲ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: taran saran suaamee raman seel paramesurah ||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Kind-hearted Lord, our Transcendent Lord and Master, we are carried across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਹ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarathah daan det prabh pooranah ||
lines.translation: God is the Perfect, All-powerful Cause of causes; He is the Giver of gifts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਾਸ ਆਸ ਕਰਣੰ ਸਗਲ ਅਰਥ ਆਲਯਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: niraas aas karana(n) sagal arath aalayah ||
lines.translation: He gives hope to the hopeless. He is the Source of all riches.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਜਾਚੰਤ ਜਾਚਿਕਹ ॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan simara(n)t naanak sagal jaacha(n)t jaachikah ||43||
lines.translation: Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Treasure of Virtue; we are all beggars, begging at His Door. ||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਗਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਸੁਗਮੰ ਮਹਾ ਦੂਖ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: duragam sathaan sugama(n) mahaa dookh sarab sookhanah ||
lines.translation: The most difficult place becomes easy, and the worst pain turns into pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਬਚਨ ਭੇਦ ਭਰਮੰ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਿਸਨੰ ਤ ਸੁਰਜਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: durabachan bhed bharama(n) saakat pisana(n) ta surajanah ||
lines.translation: Evil words, differences and doubts are obliterated, and even faithless cynics and malicious gossips become good people.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਤੰ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ ਭੈ ਖੀਣੰ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਵਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: asathita(n) sog harakha(n) bhai kheena(n) ta nirabhavah ||
lines.translation: They become steady and stable, whether happy or sad; their fears are taken away, and they are fearless.
